_default.description: Leaf symptoms require local confirmation before treatment.
_default.treatment: Retake a clear close-up photo of one affected leaf and confirm with a local agriculture officer before spraying.

_low_confidence.description: The model could not confidently identify the disease from this photo.
_low_confidence.treatment: Upload a sharper leaf-only image in natural light. Avoid mixed crops, fruit, soil, hands, or blurred backgrounds.

Apple___Apple_scab.description: Fungal apple scab causing dark leaf spots and fruit blemishes.
Apple___Apple_scab.treatment: Remove infected debris and use a locally recommended protectant fungicide at the advised interval.

Apple___Black_rot.description: Fungal black rot affecting leaves, fruit, and cankers.
Apple___Black_rot.treatment: Prune infected twigs, destroy fallen leaves and fruit, and follow local fungicide guidance.

Apple___Cedar_apple_rust.description: Rust disease with orange-yellow leaf lesions.
Apple___Cedar_apple_rust.treatment: Remove nearby alternate hosts where possible and use a recommended rust fungicide during risk periods.

Apple___healthy.treatment: No chemical treatment required. Continue regular monitoring and balanced irrigation.

Blueberry___healthy.treatment: Continue field monitoring and maintain good drainage.

Cherry_(including_sour)___Powdery_mildew.description: Powdery mildew causing white fungal growth and leaf distortion.
Cherry_(including_sour)___Powdery_mildew.treatment: Improve airflow, remove infected leaves, and apply a recommended mildew fungicide if spread continues.

Cherry_(including_sour)___healthy.treatment: No chemical treatment required. Keep monitoring new growth.

Corn_(maize)___Cercospora_leaf_spot Gray.description: Gray leaf spot in maize, usually favored by humid weather.
Corn_(maize)___Cercospora_leaf_spot Gray.treatment: Use resistant varieties, crop rotation, residue management, and local fungicide advice for severe cases.

Corn_(maize)___Common_rust_.description: Maize common rust with reddish-brown pustules.
Corn_(maize)___Common_rust_.treatment: Monitor spread and use a recommended fungicide only when infection is severe or early in crop stage.

Corn_(maize)___Northern_Leaf_Blight.description: Maize northern leaf blight with elongated gray-green lesions.
Corn_(maize)___Northern_Leaf_Blight.treatment: Use resistant hybrids, remove infected residue, rotate crops, and consult local fungicide guidance.

Corn_(maize)___healthy.treatment: No chemical treatment required. Continue scouting during humid periods.

Grape___Black_rot.description: Grape black rot causing dark leaf lesions and fruit rot.
Grape___Black_rot.treatment: Remove infected fruit and leaves, improve canopy airflow, and follow local fungicide schedules.

Grape___Esca_(Black_Measles).description: Esca complex causing interveinal striping and berry symptoms.
Grape___Esca_(Black_Measles).treatment: Prune infected wood, sanitize tools, avoid vine stress, and seek local vineyard advice.

Grape___Leaf_blight_(Isariopsis_Leaf_Spo.description: Grape leaf blight with angular brown lesions.
Grape___Leaf_blight_(Isariopsis_Leaf_Spo.treatment: Remove infected leaves, improve ventilation, and apply recommended fungicide if disease spreads.

Orange___Haunglongbing_(Citrus_greening).description: Citrus greening symptoms can include mottled yellow leaves and weak growth.
Orange___Haunglongbing_(Citrus_greening).treatment: Remove infected trees where advised, control psyllid vectors, and contact local citrus extension support.

Peach___Bacterial_spot.description: Bacterial spot causing dark lesions and shot-hole symptoms.
Peach___Bacterial_spot.treatment: Use resistant varieties, avoid overhead irrigation, and follow local copper/bactericide recommendations.

Pepper__bell___Bacterial_spot.description: Bacterial spot in bell pepper causing dark water-soaked leaf lesions.
Pepper__bell___Bacterial_spot.treatment: Remove badly infected leaves, avoid overhead irrigation, and use copper-based treatment only as locally advised.

Pepper__bell___healthy.treatment: No chemical treatment required. Maintain balanced moisture and airflow.

Potato___Early_blight.description: Early blight causing concentric brown leaf spots.
Potato___Early_blight.treatment: Remove infected foliage, avoid leaf wetness, rotate crops, and use recommended fungicide if symptoms spread.

Potato___Late_blight.description: Late blight can spread rapidly under cool, humid conditions.
Potato___Late_blight.treatment: Isolate affected plants, destroy infected foliage safely, and contact local extension support urgently.

Potato___healthy.treatment: No chemical treatment required. Keep scouting during wet weather.

Tomato_Bacterial_spot.description: Bacterial spot in tomato causing small dark lesions.
Tomato_Bacterial_spot.treatment: Remove infected leaves, avoid overhead watering, and use locally recommended copper treatment if needed.

Tomato_Early_blight.description: Early blight causing target-like brown leaf spots.
Tomato_Early_blight.treatment: Remove infected lower leaves, mulch to reduce splash, and use recommended fungicide if disease spreads.

Tomato_Late_blight.description: Late blight is a fast-spreading tomato disease in humid weather.
Tomato_Late_blight.treatment: Remove infected plants carefully, avoid leaf wetness, and seek urgent local extension advice.

Tomato_Leaf_Mold.description: Leaf mold favored by high humidity and poor ventilation.
Tomato_Leaf_Mold.treatment: Improve airflow, reduce humidity, remove infected leaves, and follow local fungicide guidance.

Tomato_Septoria_leaf_spot.description: Septoria leaf spot causing many small circular spots on lower leaves.
Tomato_Septoria_leaf_spot.treatment: Remove infected leaves, avoid splashing water, mulch soil, and rotate crops.

Tomato_Spider_mites_Two_spotted_spider_m.description: Spider mite damage causing stippling, yellowing, and webbing.
Tomato_Spider_mites_Two_spotted_spider_m.treatment: Wash leaf undersides, reduce dust stress, and use a locally recommended miticide only when needed.

Tomato__Target_Spot.description: Target spot causing circular lesions with rings.
Tomato__Target_Spot.treatment: Remove infected leaves, improve spacing, and use recommended fungicide if symptoms advance.

Tomato__Tomato_YellowLeaf__Curl_Virus.description: Viral leaf curl causing yellowing, curling, and stunted growth.
Tomato__Tomato_YellowLeaf__Curl_Virus.treatment: Remove severely infected plants and control whiteflies. Chemical treatment will not cure infected plants.

Tomato__Tomato_mosaic_virus.description: Mosaic virus causing mottled leaves and distorted growth.
Tomato__Tomato_mosaic_virus.treatment: Remove infected plants, sanitize tools, and avoid handling healthy plants after touching infected ones.

Tomato_healthy.treatment: No chemical treatment required. Continue regular field monitoring.
